harvestMethod.how: get_variable_defs on nodes that consume each variable
harvestMethod.limitation: Figma variable collections are not addressable as nodes, and get_variable_defs resolves only variables a given layer actually uses. Variables no component consumes cannot be reached this way at all.
harvestMethod.supersededBy: A one-time variables-to-JSON plugin export. Once that lands at src/design-system/_figma-export/variables.json, it becomes the source for token generation and this MCP harvest becomes the cross-check.

gaps.what: Icon set as SVG (~80 symbols on the Icons page)
gaps.why: Icons are loose symbols directly on the canvas, not inside a frame. download_assets caps at 20 SVGs per node and canvases cannot be addressed, so a bulk pull is not possible through the MCP.
